verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Honeycomb has a documented API and a downloadable OpenAPI spec, but nothing shows API versioning or a documented API deprecation policy. The 'product-lifecycle/recommended-migrations' page covers migrating off a Kubernetes agent, not API version deprecation, so it is only an adjacent feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
